commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.

90+2' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Andrea Consigli anticipates the shot and makes a decent save. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners will be replaced by Michel Adopo (Atalanta).
88' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Armand Lauriente departs the field of play to be replaced by Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo).
83' The ball is out of play. Sassuolo will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' Substitution. Sead Kolasinac makes way for Isak Hien (Atalanta).
82' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) replacing Charles De Ketelaere.
80' Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
76' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Andrea Consigli. He makes it 3:0.
74' Substitution. Emil Holm leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta).
74' Substitution. Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Aleksey Miranchuk walks off.
72' A substitution has been made. Kristian Thorstvedt goes off and Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) comes on.
72' Alessio Dionisi has decided to substitute Andrea Pinamonti and he is replaced by Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).
69' Corner kick. Atalanta will have an opportunity.
66' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
66' The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
65' The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
61' Today's match ends for Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) who will be replaced by Daniel Boloca.
60' The referee signals a substitution. Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Nedim Bajrami.
58' 2 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Emil Holm finds Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the top left corner. 2:0.
57' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
57' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
56' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Andrea Consigli. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Charles De Ketelaere races towards the box before laying off to Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta), who picks it up but drags a shot well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.

53' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
50' Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle after Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+5' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot inside the left post. Marco Carnesecchi anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
45+5' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is going to take the penalty!
45+4' The ref indicates that Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) must retake the penalty!
45+4' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) fails to keep his cool when taking the penalty and the goalkeeper makes a good save!
45+4' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+4' It’s a PENALTY to Sassuolo after the VAR review!
45+3' Referee Alessandro Prontera makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
45+2' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
45+2' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
45+1' Now Sassuolo have a corner.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
43' Andrea Consigli makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Emil Holm (Atalanta) after a cross from the side.
41' The players claim that Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
39' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

38' Ederson (Atalanta) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
31' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) spurns a big chance! He gets to the rebound but only hits the crossbar!
31' Sassuolo earn a corner.
31' He should have scored! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.

27' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.

27' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Carnesecchi reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
25' The ball goes behind for a corner. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Emil Holm (Atalanta) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
24' Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:0.
22' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Andrea Consigli stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
20' Chance! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Andrea Consigli is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
16' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) commits a rough foul. Alessandro Prontera stops the game and makes a call.
13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
12' Emil Holm (Atalanta) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.

8' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
8' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Andrea Consigli.
5' Emil Holm (Atalanta) wastes a huge opportunity after receiving a fine cross from the free kick, but his close-range shot goes well over the crossbar.
5' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
4' A clumsy foul by Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle. Atalanta win a free kick.
4' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

4' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atalanta.
2' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) runs onto a defence-splitting pass and rifles in shot that zooms just past the left post.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Alessandro Prontera will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
